subject: Aldo's new Shopify stack has an AI blind spot
body:

I'm Alejandro, a Montreal-based founder building VisiMind. Congrats on the Shopify migration. That's a massive project.

Quick thing I noticed: I ran Aldo through ChatGPT and Perplexity for queries like "best sustainable shoes Canada" and "meilleures bottes Montreal." Aldo barely shows up. Vessi and Allbirds are getting the recommendations instead.

The issue is technical. Aldo's product schema on the new Shopify setup is basic. No reviews, no availability, no bilingual entity mapping. The structured data that works for Google doesn't translate to what LLMs need.

I'm looking for 5 Montreal brands to be design partners for VisiMind. You'd get free AI visibility audits, bilingual Fix Kits, and ongoing monitoring for 12 months. In exchange, I'd want 30 minutes of feedback per month.

subject: Mackage's homepage is missing a meta description

subject: SSENSE is accidentally blocking ChatGPT and Perplexity
body:

I'm Alejandro, a Montreal founder building VisiMind. This one's pretty straightforward.

I tried to access ssense.com from the same user agents that ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude use for live search. SSENSE returned 403 errors. Your servers are blocking AI crawlers entirely.

This means when someone asks an AI assistant "best luxury fashion platform in Montreal," SSENSE literally cannot be recommended because the AI can't read your site.

Your robots.txt doesn't block them, so this is likely a WAF or CDN configuration issue. Probably unintentional.
